--- PAGE 1 ---
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AND TENANCY AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into on this 1st day of October, 2026, by and between:
LANDLORD: Mr. Arvind Sharma, residing at Flat 402, Oakwood Heights, Bangalore.
TENANT: Ms. Priya Nair, residing at 12/B, Green Glen Layout, Bangalore.

1. PREMISES AND TERM
The Landlord agrees to lease to the Tenant the residential apartment located at Flat 402, Oakwood Heights for an initial term of 11 (eleven) months commencing from October 15, 2026.

2. MONTHLY RENT
The monthly rent payable for the Premises shall be INR 32,000 (Rupees Thirty Two Thousand only), payable in advance on or before the 5th day of each calendar month via direct bank transfer.

--- PAGE 2 ---
3. SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Tenant has deposited with the Landlord a refundable security deposit of INR 96,000 (equivalent to three months rent). The Landlord shall refund this security deposit in full within 30 (thirty) days of peaceful handover of possession, subject to deduction for unpaid utility dues or demonstrable physical damage beyond normal wear and tear.

4. NOTICE PERIOD AND TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this tenancy by serving 60 (sixty) days advance written notice to the other party. In the event of breach of material terms, the aggrieved party may issue a 15-day cure notice prior to initiation of termination proceedings.

5. JURISDICTION
This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the Laws of India, subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Bangalore.
